cards.paraphrase: The opening deliberately uses contact to mean landed ships and visibly physical visitors; later passages also encourage inward perception.
cards.conditions: Opening selects a physical-contact subtype rather than declaring every use of contact physical.
cards.time_scope: Relative-year language in a recording published October 2026; utterance/event dates unverified.
cards.qualifying_note: Recognized wording contains errors; this is a description of the source’s framing, not evidence of an encounter.
cards.index_text_policy: Index paraphrase/conditions/qualifying_note only; exclude question text and query strings.

cards.paraphrase: Contact is also described as private impressions or telepathic communication, without a landed ship or multiple witnesses.
cards.conditions: Broader inclusion of subjective communication in the September recording.
cards.time_scope: September 2026 publication context.
cards.qualifying_note: Private impressions and reported telepathy are not independently observed contact events.
cards.index_text_policy: Index paraphrase/conditions/qualifying_note only; exclude question text and query strings.

cards.paraphrase: The recording predicts isolated visible contact imminently and this year, followed by public appearances beside national leaders at a later, flexible stage. It also discusses divergent predictions.
cards.conditions: Different stages of contact; later public appearances depend on humanity and timing flexibility.
cards.time_scope: Uses this-year and imminent wording but no fixed calendar date for public appearances.
cards.qualifying_note: No event verification is performed. The source explains discrepant predictions through human filters and preferred beliefs; that explanation is itself a claim.
cards.index_text_policy: Index paraphrase/conditions/qualifying_note only; exclude question text and query strings.

cards.paraphrase: The written message proposes an astral council before physical meetings and explicitly declines to give a timeframe for the physical gathering.
cards.conditions: Proposed fourth-dimensional council, distinguished from the ninth-dimensional narrator.
cards.time_scope: Published March 2019; no specified physical meeting date.
cards.qualifying_note: This is a proposed sequence in the source, not evidence that either kind of gathering occurred.
cards.index_text_policy: Index paraphrase/conditions/qualifying_note only; exclude question text and query strings.

cards.paraphrase: The interview predicts three changes in voting choices and expresses doubt about voting on election day, while explicitly saying the expectations are not set in stone and depend on a changing timeline.

cards.time_scope: July 2024 publication context; later outcomes were not checked.
cards.qualifying_note: Political forecasts are retained as unverified source assertions. Their specificity and qualification must both survive summarization.

hypotheses.title: Consolidation can lose decisive qualifiers
hypotheses.proposition: Compact cards may improve navigation while losing optionality, dates or attribution unless those fields are retained explicitly.
hypotheses.test: Compare frozen-query retrieval and qualifier retention in raw chunks, qualified cards and deliberately qualifier-stripped controls.
hypotheses.not_inferred: No brain-sleep mechanism, Google weight-training reproduction or measured human learning gain.

hypotheses.title: Similarity and contradiction are separate measurement tasks
hypotheses.proposition: High thematic similarity can coexist with differences in referent, conditions or recommended action.
hypotheses.test: Inspect same-topic pairs under a proposition/referent/time checklist; compare lexical and neural neighbor ranks without converting scores into agreement probabilities.
hypotheses.not_inferred: No corpus-wide contradiction prevalence or authenticated historical speaker.

hypotheses.title: Narrative style can masquerade as shared doctrine
hypotheses.proposition: Publisher and medium style may explain clusters otherwise interpreted as recurring spiritual entities.
hypotheses.test: Compare medium/format labels, matched-length windows, named-label masking and cross-medium neighbors.
hypotheses.not_inferred: No causal effect of medium identity or shared external source.

The opening deliberately uses contact to mean landed ships and visibly physical visitors; later passages also encourage inward perception.
Contact is also described as private impressions or telepathic communication, without a landed ship or multiple witnesses.
The recording predicts isolated visible contact imminently and this year, followed by public appearances beside national leaders at a later, flexible stage. It also discusses divergent predictions.
The written message proposes an astral council before physical meetings and explicitly declines to give a timeframe for the physical gathering.

The interview predicts three changes in voting choices and expresses doubt about voting on election day, while explicitly saying the expectations are not set in stone and depend on a changing timeline.
The message says direct inward connection to the One requires no spiritual hierarchy; teachers, forms and channeling can be optional means rather than indispensable authorities.
The message offers optional meditation or invocation with the named Andromedans and explicitly allows the practice with any being or the Creator.
The source rejects a universal formula for spiritual progress and directs the reader toward personal choice, intuition and heart-centered guidance, including freedom not to follow this teaching.
The message recommends daily inward recentering to reduce distractions and follow a personally fulfilling path.
The message frames distrust of the Universe or Creator’s support as disconnection from inner love and recommends reconnecting with that love to restore trust.
The message recommends caring for an inner child, recognizing emotional over-involvement, asserting boundaries and, in some draining situations, leaving.
The message presents a grace-embrace initiation: accepting oneself and surrounding situations is claimed to transform relationships, perception and daily creation.

The message recommends bringing emotional shadow and passion into conscious, nonjudgmental awareness rather than suppressing them, while acknowledging that these forces can be manipulative or unbalanced.
The source recommends self-responsibility, reducing debt and developing tangible skills or resources, while explicitly distinguishing voluntary community sharing from isolation and hoarding.

The sampled interview urges small environmental actions, less personal blame and reconsidering whether everything depends on a political outcome; it emphasizes cooperation, hope and a pause to breathe.
The recording links contact preparation with intention and meditation and describes change as potentially transforming existing relationships rather than automatically abandoning a job or spouse.
The Council of Contact is described as a convenient name for a loose, fluid collective, with beings or frequencies coming and going.
The Council of Contact is described as a group of contact specialists from varied races, planets and dimensions, with an explicit rejection of hierarchical superiority.
The text identifies its narrator as the nonphysical ninth-dimensional Arcturian Council, which proposes a separate physical council and says it will not sit on that council in physical form.

The interview describes the Council of Nine as interdimensional guardians representing Earth, with members associated with Venus, the Pleiades and Lyra; channeling is described as listening/repeating or possible takeover.
The printed response accepts the premise and develops claims about inherited attitudes toward gold, then recommends self-sufficiency, tangible resources and lower debt.
The printed response says yes, then contrasts dependency with self-responsibility and stresses community sharing rather than hoarding.
The brief printed response says that possession is not perceived as wealth.
The printed response says those who want them, then describes surplus and an Equal Value System in which wealth is not defined through relative scarcity.
The printed response says the technology is possible but portrays present fear, hoarding and scarcity attitudes as barriers, recommending self-responsibility, skills and sharing.
